messages:
maria: FYI staging canary failing on image extract during release window, looks like kaniko OOM when unpacking multipart layers.
devon: saw that too, runner logs show repeated EOF while streaming layer, maybe cache eviction.
samir: tagging logs: `kaniko: unexpected EOF while reading tar stream` and `write tmp: no space left on device` in ephemeral runner.
june: deploy-bot just auto-held the promo: `promo status: held (artifact extract failures)` and posted the canary failure link.
deploy-bot: Promo held by CI health check: 3/3 canary smoke failures. Reason: layer extract errors. Manual pin allowed by release lead.
ryan: do we have a last-good-image to pin to?
maria: yes, previous canary 1719987654 passed smoke at 09:12 UTC. We can pin to that if we want to unblock.
devon: +1 for pin. but we should also try a cache warmup rerun — kaniko + runner disk pressure is suspicious.
ci-orchestrator: queued job 1722223400: staging-warmup-cache (priority: high) — will retry kaniko with increased workspace and 3x backoff.
samir: action: i'll re-run the warmup, and temporarily bump runner ephemeral storage to 30GB for the job. If warmup passes, we can attempt manual promote.
june: release lead decision needed: pin or wait for rerun? change window ends in 45m.
maria: pin to 1719987654, manual promote now. Then follow up with warmup and infra fix post-promote. minimize customer risk.
dry-run: (dev shorthand) samir, please note to capture disk metrics and upload `/var/log/kaniko/*.log` to the thread.
samir: will do. starting warmup now, ETA ~6m.
ci-orchestrator: warmup job started (job id 1722223412).
devon: also opening a quick PR to add a temporary kaniko workspace increase to config for staging runners. Link: https://git.redwood/s/repo/pull/2145
ryan: if warmup fails we'll revert and stick with the pin. if warmup succeeds we can consider unholding and promoting the new build, but prefer pin for immediate unblock.
june: OK official: pin to 1719987654 and manual promote. samir proceed with warmup and collect logs. devon proceed with infra PR. I'll note in release notes: pinned canary due to staging kaniko extract OOM; follow-up infra fix planned.
maria: noted, performing manual promote now.
deploy-bot: Manual promote requested by @june. Promote queued.
ci-orchestrator: warmup job finished: success. kaniko extract completed on rerun after workspace bump. logs uploaded: https://ci.redwood/logs/1722223412/kaniko-warmup.log
samir: uploaded host disk metrics as well. attaching relevant snippet:
```
Disk avail before: 6GB
Disk avail after warmup: 28GB
kaniko extract errors -> gone after bump
```

devon: will merge the temp runner workspace PR and schedule a follow-up to tune retention/cleanup.
june: closing decision: keep pin, promote done, schedule postmortem and permanent fix. Thanks all :thumbsup:
ryan: adding release notes blurb and a follow-up ticket for infra.
maria: thanks folks, marking the release window green for now.
